name: Thue
source:
One of the Triad. It's hinted that she had yuri relationships with her twin-sister Anne. She always challenges with her sister but likes her a lot.

[spoiler]She was killed during the battle for Sect Falcon's palace and resurrected by Nero.[/spoiler]
